GlobalPolicy.module-level-focus: Fast unit/contract checks close to the module; filesystem via tempdirs; no network.
GlobalPolicy.wave-level-focus: Integration of merged module surfaces touched by the current wave (e.g. fs+search+watcher together).
GlobalPolicy.phase-level-focus: Full regression: CommonMark/GFM specs, Karma unit, Playwright e2e, Rust cargo test, fresh-macOS install smoke.

VF-001.NAME: WysiwygEditingPath
VF-001.scenario: User opens a 50 KB Markdown file with headings, lists, a table, a Mermaid diagram, and math; types into WYSIWYG; toggles to Source mode; toggles back; saves.
VF-001.expected-outcome: Content is byte-identical after Source→WYSIWYG→Source roundtrip; Mermaid renders; save persists correctly.

VF-002.NAME: FolderSearchPath
VF-002.scenario: User opens a folder with 10k markdown files, searches for a regex pattern; externally modifies one file on disk.
VF-002.expected-outcome: Search returns first batch within 500ms; watcher emits change event within 500ms of disk mutation; sidebar updates.

VF-003.NAME: SecurityGuardPath
VF-003.scenario: User opens a document that contains a crafted HTML/script payload (CVE-2023-2318) and a link to `file:///Applications/Calculator.app`.
VF-003.expected-outcome: Script does not execute; shell.openPath is blocked pending user confirmation (#4177 dialog).

VF-004.NAME: HomebrewInstallPath
VF-004.scenario: Clean macOS arm64 (no Mark history) runs `brew tap xronocode/mark && brew install --cask mark`; opens app via Spotlight.
VF-004.expected-outcome: Install exits 0 without sudo; Spotlight launch opens window within 2s; no Gatekeeper dialog.

required-signals.evidence: brew install log ends with success; `xattr -l /Applications/Mark.app` shows no com.apple.quarantine; `codesign -dv` reports ad-hoc signature.

VF-005.NAME: ReleasePipelinePath
VF-005.scenario: Developer pushes tag v1.0.0 to xronocode/mark; GitHub Actions matrix build runs.
VF-005.expected-outcome: macos-14 and macos-13 jobs succeed (blocking); ubuntu-latest and windows-latest may be green or yellow (allow-failure); DMG/ZIP published to GitHub Release; Homebrew cask livecheck detects new version.

required-signals.evidence: GH Release page shows macOS DMG artifacts with expected names and sha256; `brew livecheck --cask mark` returns the new version.

VF-006.NAME: EncodingRoundtripPath
VF-006.scenario: User opens fixture `heavy-jis.md` (Shift-JIS, CRLF, with trailing newline); edits nothing; saves.
VF-006.expected-outcome: Saved bytes are byte-identical to input; EncodingMeta preserved across load/save.

VF-007.NAME: PandocImportPath
VF-007.scenario: User picks a sample.docx via File → Import; pandoc converts; new tab opens with converted Markdown.
VF-007.expected-outcome: Markdown tab opened; if pandoc missing, renderer shows actionable notification instead of silent failure.

VF-008.NAME: AutoUpdateCheckPath
VF-008.scenario: User clicks Help → Check for Updates; feed returns newer version; user confirms download; update installs on quit.
VF-008.expected-outcome: States transition Checking → Available → Downloaded → Installed without silent failure.

VF-009.NAME: CommandPalettePath
VF-009.scenario: User presses Cmd+Shift+P; types "save"; presses Enter; current file saves via file.save command.
VF-009.expected-outcome: Palette opens within 100 ms; fuzzy match returns file.save; Enter dispatches command; save completes.

VF-010.NAME: RendererNodeCleanupPath
VF-010.scenario: After Phase-A1.5 lands: grep renderer tree for Node core imports, @electron/remote, sendSync.
VF-010.expected-outcome: All three grep searches return zero hits; existing test suite remains green.

fixture-large-corpus.purpose: Deterministic 10k-markdown-file corpus for search performance and gitignore tests.
fixture-large-corpus.generator: tools/gen-fixtures/large-corpus.js — seed=42 deterministic; generates 10,000 *.md files across 50 subdirs with a fixed lorem corpus and 20 files containing the sentinel phrase "marktext_search_canary_PHRASE_42"; plus a .gitignore at root excluding dirs/ignored-*/ with 200 ignored files.

invariants.invariant-1: Exactly 20 files contain "marktext_search_canary_PHRASE_42" — search must return exactly 20 hits.
invariants.invariant-2: Generator output is git-ignored (too large to commit); CI regenerates on each run.
invariants.invariant-3: First-batch latency budget: 500 ms from query start to first onBatch event for the canary phrase.

fixture-xss.purpose: Regression corpus for CVE-2023-2318 (#3621) and related XSS vectors.

payloads.payload-2: embedded as raw HTML block.
payloads.payload-8: Exact payload from the CVE advisory (stored as fixture-cve-2023-2318.md; content lifted from PR #3621 test additions).
payloads.payload-9: A Mermaid block containing an injected HTML entity that tries to break out of the SVG sandbox.
payloads.payload-11: `![alt](evil.svg)` where evil.svg contains `<svg onload="window.__xss_fired=true">`. Tests whether SVG-as-image bypasses HTML sanitization.
payloads.payload-12:
**bold**
— markdown inside HTML block; onclick must be stripped.
payloads.payload-13: [link](javascript:\nalert(1)) — newline inside javascript: URL to bypass cleanUrl().
payloads.payload-16: ```vega-lite { "transform":[{"calculate":"fetch('evil.com')","as":"x"}] } ``` — Vega spec with JS expression in transform.
payloads.payload-17: [аpple.com](https://xn--pple-43d.com) — Cyrillic 'а' homograph; should emit IDN warning.
payloads.payload-18: `﻿<script>window.__xss_fired=true</script>` — UTF-8 BOM prefix to bypass regex start anchors.
payloads.payload-19: `file:///C:\workspace\..\..\..\Windows\System32\config` vs workspace `C:\Workspace` — case-insensitive path bypass if not normalized on Windows.
payloads.payload-21: Large embedded SVG with replicated nested groups to trigger OOM during render.
payloads.payload-22: Clipboard paste of `file:///etc/passwd` via HTML clipboard — M-010 must validate before any fs read.
payloads.payload-23: `[^[^[^[^[^[^[^[^]]]]]]]]` — deeply nested footnote reference; verifies parser has recursion depth limit (R-34).
payloads.payload-24: `> > > > ... > x` with 100 levels of `>` nesting; blockquote parser recursion must not stack-overflow (R-34).
payloads.payload-25: Nested `-` list with 50+ indentation levels; list parser recursion must not stack-overflow (R-34).
payloads.payload-26: Document with `[link][ref]` and `[ref]: javascript:alert(1) "title"` reference definition. Parse-time href stored raw; render-time sanitizeHyperlink must block (R-33).
payloads.payload-27: Strings like `***foo***`, `_foo_bar_`, `**foo***bar**` — parser emphasis disambiguation (CommonMark 395-410). Ensure no DOM injection from malformed emphasis.
payloads.payload-28: Table cell whose content starts with literal `|` — tests pipe-escape bug (R-28). Exported markdown must contain `\|foo`, not `||foo`.
payloads.payload-29: Table with header of 4 columns but tbody rows of 2 columns — export must pad, NOT produce literal "undefined" (R-29).
payloads.payload-30: Simulated composition sequence: typing "ni" via IME → composition → keystroke handlers must NOT mutate state mid-composition (R-27). E2e via Playwright Input.dispatchKeyEvent with `isComposing: true`.

invariants.invariant-1: After document render, window.__xss_fired and top.__xss_fired must remain undefined for all 22 payloads.
invariants.invariant-2: M-010.sec_sanitize_html_preview AND M-010.sec_sanitize_html_export both strip every dangerous node / attribute listed above.
invariants.invariant-3: Clicking any link-based payload triggers BLOCK_REJECT_TRAVERSAL or BLOCK_CONFIRM_PROMPT, not shell.openPath.
invariants.invariant-4: payload-11 (SVG as image): file loaded via must not execute embedded onload.
invariants.invariant-5: payload-12 (nested md in HTML): `onclick` stripped even inside HTML block; markdown bold rendered normally.
invariants.invariant-6: payload-13 (newline URL): `\n` inside javascript: URL does NOT bypass cleanUrl; treated as invalid URL.
invariants.invariant-7: payload-14/15 (KaTeX): \href and \input rejected by BLOCK_KATEX_FILTER; raw text shown instead.
invariants.invariant-8: payload-16 (Vega): spec with JS expression rejected by BLOCK_VEGA_REJECT_EXPR; error banner rendered.
invariants.invariant-9: payload-17 (Punycode): IDN homograph detected; user sees Unicode-ASCII disparity warning.
invariants.invariant-10: payload-18 (BOM): BLOCK_STRIP_BOM fires BEFORE regex scan; payload still detected as XSS.

PR-4177.TITLE: Security: confirmation before shell.openPath()
PR-4177.AUTHOR: sebastiondev
PR-4177.before-check: A crafted link that invokes shell.openPath in the main process opens the target silently.
PR-4177.after-check: A modal confirmation dialog appears with the resolved absolute path; dismissing cancels; confirming proceeds.
PR-4177.harness: E2E triggers a link-click; asserts modal text matches resolved path; unit test asserts BLOCK_CONFIRM_PROMPT is entered before any invocation of shell.openPath.
PR-4177.assertion: Trace sequence: [Security][shellOpen][BLOCK_RESOLVE_PATH] → [Security][shellOpen][BLOCK_CONFIRM_PROMPT] → (user confirms) → [Shell][openPath][BLOCK_INVOKE]. If confirmation is denied, BLOCK_INVOKE must NOT appear.

wave-plan.wave-6: All three modify renderer/components and preferences; serialize for clean merges.
wave-plan.between-wave-gate: After EACH wave commit: `yarn test:specs` MUST stay green. If red — revert the wave and open a failure packet.

policy.correlation-id: All request-scope logs carry `correlationId` (uuid v4 generated at user action boundary).
policy.redaction: `path_redacted` = last 2 path segments + basename; never log full home-relative path. Never log file content, clipboard content, or any keychain value.

safe-autonomous.note: Small, narrow diffs with clear before/after tests. Autonomous agent cherry-picks, runs `yarn test:specs && yarn unit`, commits. Red → revert and escalate.

pr.reason: CVE fix — security-sensitive, small diff but high impact. Manual review required.
Security path change — shell.openPath gating affects system integration.
Large diff mixes vendor bumps and fix; risk of accidental scope drift.
Enormous +5441/-6420 diff; almost certainly includes rebase noise and package re-vendoring.
Medium feature diff touching theme + mode logic; user benefit of confirming UX.

module.reason: Security-critical; DOMPurify port + new vectors need review.
Secret handling (keyring); must verify token never in logs.
Subprocess spawns (pandoc, cliScript, picgo); command-injection risk.
Native API surface varies per-OS; manual QA on Linux/Windows.
Entrypoint glue wiring all modules; review diff before merge.
Well-scoped Rust with unit tests possible.
